name: Bemobi Mobile Tech S.A.
summary: Bemobi Mobile Tech S.A., a technology company, provides solutions and mobile platforms for digital payments, customer engagement, microfinance, and digital services in Brazil and internationally. The company offers Bemobi Pay, which includes smart checkouts which offers white-label and customizable solution, payment method orchestration, and multiple payment methods; Smart POS, that accepts payments; Payment Orchestration which optimizes payments and connects business to multiple providers, increase approval rates, and reduce fraud; and simplify payment management.
